notes.title: Chef's Tail Patch #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/f4743896be91172031ee297ef0fd80eef5be4925.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hello friends!
We've gathered all the feedback from you (thanks for it <3) and prepared the first Chef's Tail Update #1[/b][/h3]

[b]What was changed (all on the graphic but there you go^^):[/b]
-fixed the critical bug that occurred when attempting to gift Eros and Anteros (now their reputation is maxed out from the beginning as it should be!)
-shop UI improvements - now the shopping interface has cleaner colors and bigger fonts - a lot more colorblind-friendly!
-fixed the bug with the 4th gift with every NPC -no more crashes!
-lot of random minor bug fixes

[b]Join our discord channel and share with us what you think:[/b]

have fun!
Chef's Tail team

This time has come for us, that’s why we would like to invite you all to Climber: Sky is the Limit’s campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/climberskyisthelimit/climber-sky-is-the-limit]KICKSTARTER[/url]!

notes.title: Chef's Devlog #4 - Characters: Eros & Anteros
notes.notes:
[b]Hello friends![/b]
Let's dive deeper into the Chef's Tail character cast, 
today we want to introduce to you the Underworld most famous brothers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/02bacd203c5e60611bfe294b78ec627e943c2f57.jpg[/img]
[b]Eros[/b]

and 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/0611c904b5aa8e5c4fed6445f43b8c01dea44574.jpg[/img]
[b]Anteros[/b]

Their names were inspired by Greek brothers, gods of love and desire. In Chef's Tail, they are no longer in the business, instead, they took their talents to the fashion industry! They will sell skins and accessories for you to wear and become [b]the fanciest Underworld cook![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/d4be8467a1b34f2f06f700ee4846489c4da68cc1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/3152784bd8f114a23f2fd8e833cdb4debcf968b3.jpg[/img]

Maybe they didn't inherit their mythological counterpart job, but sure they did liking for jokes and pranks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/0f952cfbc7cfd27c6526c1cdf8d8f6a3831ca869.jpg[/img]
(Eros about his brother)

[b]have a great day!
Art Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: Chef's Devlog #3 - Characters: Oracle
notes.notes:
[b]Hello friends![/b]
After a quick update about new skins and accessories, we're back to key characters of the Underworld.
One of the most important (or even the most important one) is the [b]Oracle[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/d2544d061d8516c13d4bf3f807bee5dfbbf8f278.png[/img]

Just like in myths, she retains her ability to peer into the future, but in "Chef’s Tail" she uses it to help souls find their way through the Underworld.
If you lose your path and can't figure out how to perform your duties in this world, she will not let you fall into despair. But instead of divining your future, she helps with more material things, [b]like selling you a frying pan[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/9bab1787b4eb3cd133d1ca1fdbf5f5d6d940b753.png[/img]

You can always count on her telling a few kind words to your furry ear too. 
[b]Figure out how those mystical powers of her work! [/b]

[b]Until we see each other again, 
Art Games Studio [/b]

notes.title: Chef's Devlog #1 - Characters: Charon
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
This is the first from the series of Devlogs that will precede the release of Chef's Tail. 
We will be updating you with the newest information from the game, as well as some sneak peeks into development, to help you understand the world of Chef's Tail and our creative vision.

As you know, Underworld is quite an abundant theme in mythology, for the narrative design of the game that could be either a boon or a bane. 
On one hand, we have all those incredible characters from the Greek epic poems. On the other hand, we certainly wanted a more light-hearted experience for the game. We also wanted to create something unique, world-building-wise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/5af5bb04727a957f91f3b40a55f6478a7a80289d.png[/img]

That’s how one of the quest givers -[b] Charon[/b], became part of the game.
Charon’s duty is to transport the souls to the Underworld. But unlike in Greek mythology, the souls are not going to stay in this Underworld forever. 
With some luck and a bit of obols (ancient currency), they may, very well, reach their next destination even in a few hours! 
This makes our Charon’s duty a lot less grim and dark compared to original myths. Yes, he is still moody and bad-tempered, though caring as an old, but grumpy grandpa. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000827/28e9aace4ef320294bf129bdce57af0afac42e90.png[/img]

Charon is the first character you meet and one of the key figures in Chef's Tail. 


That’s all for this Devlog. Stay safe, and wait for more news from the Underworld!

[b]With love,
Art Games Studio.[/b]
